profile.summary: Technology has the power to make a real difference, not only by streamlining current methods, but by introducing new opportunities that were not possible in the past. The rate at which the technology sector progresses, means that it is important to ensure that the decisions and investments we make in the technology we build are flexible enough to account for that growth.

projects.title: Dissertation - Campus Navigation
projects.description:
Investigated the use of wireless technologies in the context of user navigation. This consisted of evaluating past research, designing and developing a a small-scale navigation system made up of Bluetooth beacons, an smartphone and a NOSQL Graph database.

The developed system was then tested by 10 users in a university campus building, in order to understand how much value it provided over the traditional methods implemented at the university, such as paper maps and signage.

The research suggested that while the implemented system in it's unfinished state, did not provide much value, the idea had some serious grounds. The users were able to see themselves using similar systems in the coming years.

projects.title: Studio Monitor
projects.description:
This was an individual project to produce a monitoring tool for use by production staff; to track and review video clip production times.
Analysed the problem and produced a plan of each of the project activities to ensure key deadlines were met.
Compiled a system diagram to show how the sub-systems interact with each other to provide the solution.
Interviewed /the Production Manager to acquire current production estimates and discuss the types of logs needed to review the time-scales of producing video clips.
Evaluated possible designs to come up with clear, eye-catching UI designs.
